group-5-half-victory-grin.script: Lean in hard. Huge grins. Someone points up. Hold the win!

group-5-half-matching-tilt.script: Tilt the same direction. Same smile size. Same timing. Hold the tilt!

group-5-half-frame-one.script: Choose one person. Everyone else frames their face. That person poses. Hold the frame!

group-5-half-blink-on-three.script: Eyes open. Count together. Blink once. Reopen and smile!

group-5-half-stillness-challenge.script: Find a face. Hands freeze. No wiggling. Hold completely still!
